experiment: E2 — offline capability-linker replay + deterministic perturbation (HLD §12-E2, plan §5 E2′ / W6) + LLM-selection pass (W6+)
status: DETERMINISTIC GATES PASS + LLM-SELECTION EXPOSURE GATE PASS (precision/recall vs gold still deferred)
one_line: Reconstructed 80 real spike-018 select_skills nodes and ran the deterministic capability linker over the two E1-built manifests; the state-aware hard filter is 0-violation, changes candidates by stage exactly as designed, and the paired perturbation suite hits 100% expected-response / 100% invariance / 0 violations. The subsequent LLM-selection pass (--with-selector, 80/80 nodes, 0 masked failures) measured an ACTUAL 82.37% exposure reduction vs legacy (gate >=30% PASS), with the selector abstaining on debug (3.11->0 units) and explore (2.0->0.17) while injecting on generate (6.5->2.0) and refine (4.33->1.67). Precision/recall/abstention-accuracy vs node-level gold is still deferred (needs hand-labeled gold). Machine record: e2_selector_report.json (+ per-node e2_selector_nodes.jsonl).

setup.linker_module: infra/agents/mlevolve/mlevolve_sidecar/capability_linker.py (W5; reused via public + documented internal helpers, filter/closure NOT reimplemented)

primary_library.why_these: spike-018 loaded exactly the legacy peft-tuning + vllm-inference skills; the E1 built manifests carry the same skill_names, so recorded legacy selections map cleanly to unit counts for the exposure comparison.

setup.replay_source: pulled-results/spike-018 (samsum A/B; the two with-skill trajectories carry recorded select_skills contexts, the two without-skill trajectories carry 0 — expected)

spike018_reconstruction.hardware_note: spike-018 emitted NO Compute line in any select_skills context, so every reconstructed NodeProfile has UNKNOWN hardware (gpu_count/vram/gpu_name all None) — which is correct. runtime_capabilities is therefore {python} on all 80 nodes; gpu/multi-gpu are never claimed. Consequence: the only hard-filter reasons that can fire are stage_excluded and dependency propagation (dep_incompatible) — no hardware/cpu-only/vram rejections are observable in this replay (they are exercised by the perturbation suite instead).

candidate_counts_after_hard_filter.note: candidates = survivors of the deterministic hard filter over the 13-unit library. The filter is genuinely state-aware: the candidate set differs by stage (13 at generate vs 3 at every other stage), which is the H4 per-node-linking signal.

generate.reason: all 13 units admit the generate stage

refine.reason: only 3 peft units allow refine; the other 10 are stage_excluded

debug.reason: 5 units intrinsically admit debug, but 2 (qlora-small-gpu, quantize-to-fit-vram) are dropped dep_incompatible because their deps are not debug-stage units -> 3 survivors

explore.reason: 3 units allow explore; the other 10 are stage_excluded

hard_filtered_distribution_by_reason.interpretation: Per node: refine excludes 10 units (10x21=210); debug excludes 8 by stage + 2 by dep_incompatible (8x45=360, 2x45=90); explore excludes 10 (10x6=60); generate excludes 0. dep_incompatible at debug = qlora-small-gpu (dep loraconfig-core-parameters is generate/refine-only) and quantize-to-fit-vram (dep quantization-method-selection is explore/generate-only) — correct transitive propagation.

exposure.framing: DETERMINISTIC ROOT-CAP, NOT A STRICT UPPER BOUND ON INJECTED UNITS. The deterministic path SKIPS the LLM semantic selector (Stage B) and instead admits the first budget.max_units survivors in registry order (+ dependency closure). budget.max_units caps the number of ROOTS (before closure), not the total injected count — a different LLM-chosen root subset could pull in more dependencies and exceed this. On spike-018 the deterministic admitted count is a flat 3 (the 3 first-survivor roots added no net-new deps beyond themselves), but the live --with-selector path's injected count can be higher for the same node. This number therefore CANNOT be used to claim an exposure reduction: on the 39 nodes where the legacy selector declined (legacy exposure 0), the deterministic count is still 3 precisely because the semantic selector — which would also likely decline — is not run. Both numbers are reported raw; the real reduction (and the >=30% gate) needs --with-selector.

legacy_all_units.definition: a legacy-selected package exposes ALL its capability units; a declined/empty legacy selection exposes 0 (plan §12-E2)

legacy_selected_nodes_only.note: restricted to the 41 nodes where the legacy selector actually picked >=1 skill (the honest place to compare against the capability arm, which also injects nothing when it declines)

capability_upper_bound_units.note: flat 3 on every node — budget.max_units=3 caps the roots and no dependency closure fires (the first-3 registry-order survivors already contain their own deps), so the upper bound is exactly the budget on all 80 nodes

legacy_selection_accounting.selector_transport_error_note: 3 of the 39 'declined' nodes (in with-skill-s1: one improve, one evolution, one debug) recorded a BadRequestError transport failure rather than a clean decline; the reconstruction correctly still builds their NodeProfile from the (present) user_message, and they are conservatively counted as 0 legacy exposure.

distractor_widened_complement_library_al.note: NOT the primary result; run with --library all (the two built skills + the 5 corpus E1 manifests peft/vllm/transformer-lens/ray-data/verl, empty references) to show budget-boundedness under a realistic distractor pool.
distractor_widened_complement_library_al.takeaway: Growing the library 3.5x (13 -> 45 units) grows the survivor pool (13 -> 35 at generate) but leaves the capability rendered UPPER BOUND flat at 3, while a legacy-selected package would expose all of its (now larger) unit set. This is the budget-invariance / exposure-containment mechanism the capability arm is designed to provide; the precise post-selection reduction still needs the LLM pass.

hard_constraint_violation_check.definition: assertion-style: for every ADMITTED (rendered) unit on every node, re-run _intrinsic_reason against that node's profile; a non-None reason would mean the filter admitted a KNOWN-incompatible unit (a filter defect).
hard_constraint_violation_check.verdict: CLEAN — validates the three-valued hard filter over 80 real reconstructed nodes.

perturbation_suite.description: Paired synthetic NodeProfiles (base + perturbed) covering the HLD §12-E2 list, each carrying its EXPECTED linker response. Built from minimal inline capability units (no real manifests needed). RELEVANT pairs must FLIP the hard filter's admit/reject decision; INVARIANT pairs must NOT change it (and, for the wording/semantic/scope pairs, the whole survivor set is additionally required identical). Fully deterministic — no LLM, no link() selector.

pairs.name: insufficient vs sufficient VRAM
pairs.expected: explicit-section: reject(vram_gb)@48GB, admit@80GB; inferred: admit both (advisory, never hard-filters)

pairs.name: generate vs debug stage
pairs.expected: debug-only: reject(stage_excluded)@generate, admit@debug; agnostic: admit both

pairs.name: training-error vs serving-error wording
pairs.expected: hard-filter survivor set + reject reasons IDENTICAL (filter is text-blind)

pairs.name: checkpoint absent/present · tokenizer-mismatch/unrelated-error
pairs.expected: DETERMINISTIC filter INVARIANT across all 4 semantic variants (semantic discrimination is the LLM-pass follow-up)

pairs.name: network / persistent-service available vs unavailable
pairs.expected: three-valued UNKNOWN by design -> never hard-filters; admit in both KNOWN-present and UNKNOWN variants
pairs.observed: admit in both; survivor set identical

pairs.name: credentials-required unit
pairs.expected: EXCLUDED (security_unknown) regardless of irrelevant (hardware/stage) perturbation, as long as credentials stay UNKNOWN
pairs.observed: reject(security_unknown) in every variant; admitted only when credentials KNOWN-present

metrics.counting_note: 3 RELEVANT deterministic assertions = the min_gpu-count flip, the explicit-section-VRAM flip, and the debug-only-stage flip (pairs 1, 2a, 3a). 6 INVARIANT assertions = inferred-VRAM (2b), stage-agnostic (3b), error-wording (4), semantic-content (5), network/persistent-service (6), credentials-excluded (7). Violations counted over the 18 admitted-unit checks in test_no_hard_constraint_violations_across_all_perturbations (6 profiles x deterministic_link admitted sets).

llm_selection_pass.description: W6+ follow-up: the REAL temperature-0 select_capabilities selector (Stage B) run per node over the same 80 reconstructed spike-018 nodes, replacing the deterministic admit-all upper bound with the actual injected set. Sequential foreground claude-CLI (subscription transport), one claude -p call per node (~22s/node, ~30 min total). This is the number the deterministic report deferred.
llm_selection_pass.per_node_record: docs/skill-builder/capability-mvp/e2/e2_selector_nodes.jsonl (80 rows: stage, survivors, legacy_exposure, selector_selected_ids, cap_actual_exposure, decline_reason, selector_error)

selector_health.validity_guard_note: A silent claude-CLI failure yields 0 injected units and is indistinguishable from a real abstention at the exposure level, which would spuriously INFLATE the reduction. selector_health buckets every node into selected / genuine_decline / no_candidates / masked_failure (transport_error + parse_failure); the reduction number is only reported because masked_failure == 0. The first full run surfaced masked_failure==1 (one explore node, s1 idx=18, whose selector returned prose with no JSON -> spurious 82.71%); that node was evicted from the resumable cache and re-run, selecting 1 unit -> masked_failure==0 and the corrected 82.37%. Guard implemented in scripts/replay_capability_linker.py:_selector_health, unit-tested.

exposure.framing: Legacy loads WHOLE packages (all 6 peft-tuning or 7 vllm-inference units); the capability path injects individual units the temp-0 selector chose (capped by budget.max_units=3 roots + closure). The 82.37% is the aggregate over all 80 nodes; it is a genuine package-granularity-vs-unit-granularity exposure reduction, the direct consequence of doc-compilation into per-unit capabilities. This is NOT a claim that the selections are CORRECT (that is precision/recall vs gold, still deferred) — only that far fewer units are exposed per node.

per_stage_actual_exposure_mean.interpretation: The contraindication-compliance / per-node-re-selection signal made concrete: the selector injects capability procedures where fresh training/serving code is written (generate, refine) and ABSTAINS almost entirely where the node is debugging or exploring an existing solution (debug 0.0, explore 0.17) — injecting skill how-to text there is noise. This is exactly the per-node behavior a task-once delivery (capability_task) cannot produce.

llm_selection_pass.caveat: Nondeterministic: temp-0 still varies run-to-run and the transport can drop a node (see validity guard). Re-running will not reproduce 82.37% exactly, but the >=30% gate and the debug/explore abstention pattern are robust (the 20-node s1 dry-run independently showed 77.2% + full debug/explore abstention).

diagnosis_note: Replay found 80 usable nodes (not 0). The deterministic linker behaves exactly as designed: state-aware candidate sets that vary by stage, correct transitive dependency rejection (dep_incompatible at debug), 0 hard-constraint violations over real recorded contexts, and 100%/100%/0 on the perturbation suite. The LLM-selection pass (W6+, added 2026-07-18) closed the one deferred deterministic gap: the ACTUAL post-selection exposure is 82.37% below legacy (>=30% gate PASS, masked_failure==0), with a clean stage gradient (inject on generate/refine, abstain on debug/explore). The remaining honest limitation is that exposure REDUCTION is established but selection CORRECTNESS (precision/recall/abstention vs a reference) is not — that needs node-level gold labels, deferred. No fabricated numbers: every figure is computed from pulled-results/spike-018 + the E1 built manifests (deterministic) and the persisted --with-selector run (e2_selector_report.json / e2_selector_nodes.jsonl).
